change_summary: Classify future reliance before announcing a no-write plan, then preserve large selected sources before exhaustive Host-side parsing so Corvio owns bounded carrier-aware Work Model reconciliation.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill now classifies future continuity by meaning rather than save/upload keywords and sends exact large sources to the carrier-aware Work Model path before exhaustive Host parsing.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-15.4 places semantic future-reliance classification before any no-write promise and projects the upload-first boundary through MCP while preserving Agent-owned topology planning and typed Runtime receipts.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.44 without changing transport, trust, consent, or compatibility-family boundaries.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Public guidance distinguishes semantic future reliance from ordinary one-off delivery and directs large selected sources through exact retention before exhaustive local parsing.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart preserve the ordinary-deliverable consent boundary while making an explicit future-reliance request visible before Host-native full-file parsing can consume the turn.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history adds the live two-PDF Host miss and keeps its repair in semantic intent routing and source-transfer order rather than Runtime topology enforcement.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.44 publication and hashes can be verified here; Claude directory acceptance and fresh secondary-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover semantic future-reliance triggers, upload-before-exhaustive-parse guidance, adapter convergence, ordinary-deliverable and local-only countercases, package export, and localized Help; the failed J2T1 receipt and fresh rerun are the live behavior gate.
